name: FormatVariantAndSourceEvidence
description: In-memory passive document evidence and the real two-adapter seam.
schema_def: FormatVariantDescriptor {variantId, adapterVersion, extractionPolicyVersion, manifestSchemaVersion, supportedMediaType, hardLimits}
PdfDocumentEvidence {sourceFingerprint, byteLength, pages[{pageNumber, width, height, orderedGlyphs[{value, boundingBox, contentOrder}]}]}
SourceRecordEvidence {sourceRecordId, pageNumber, recordOrdinal, recordKind, originalTextEvidence, sourceReference?, financialEvidence: FinancialEvidence, runningBalanceMinor?, sourceControlMinor?}

ExtractedStatement {variant, statementPeriod: StatementPeriod, accountEvidence: StatementAccountEvidence, orderedRecords[], openingEconomicBalanceMinor?, closingEconomicBalanceMinor?, advertisedControls[]}

FinancialEvidence is the existing normalization input {amount, currencyCode, description, balanceIncreased, transactionDate?, postingDate?, yearlessMonthDay?, statementPeriod}; adapters extract it without applying account-class sign conversion. Preview passes the selected AccountDetail.AccountClass and each FinancialEvidence to FinancialNormalizer, then passes normalized movement plus per-record running/source controls and statement opening/closing balances to StatementReconciler.

IStatementAdapter exposes Descriptor, Probe(PdfDocumentEvidence), and Extract(PdfDocumentEvidence, AccountDetail selectedAccount). AccountDetail is the exact released DM-LEDGER-ACCOUNT contract; accountId, AccountClass, currencyCode, and masked identity metadata are consumed without wrapper translation or private lookup. Exactly two implementations are registered in v1 and exactly one probe must match.
